correctness.rationale: For each genuine complex two-dimensional pencil, the cited resolution by kappa blowups of P^2 has unimodular H,E_{i,l} intersection lattice. Contracted exceptional curves are specified consecutive differences E_{i,l}-E_{i,l+1} along each Jordan chain except at distinct block-size breaks; in regular case the line B=H-sum E is additionally contracted. These differences form a primitive sublattice (quotient identifies path-interval coefficients); adjoining B remains primitive because its H coefficient is 1 modulo that sublattice. As all nontrivial fibers are trees of rational curves, the integral Leray restriction H²(tilde Y,Z)-> H^0(R²f_*Z) pairs with each contracted irreducible curve and is onto, so H³(Y,Z)=0 and H²(Y,Z) is the exact integral perpendicular lattice, not merely its rational span. Orthogonality forces constant b_p on intervals of length d_p; singular case a free gives Gram diag(1,-d_1,...,-d_r), while regular B condition a+sum d_p b_p=0 gives G_{pq}=d_p*d_q-delta_pq*d_p. Rank-one determinant lemma yields |det G|=(kappa-1)prod d_p. H¹=0, H⁴=Z from degree-one proper map, cohomology above real dimension four vanishes. Normal/smooth compactifications and r=0 singular, kappa>=2 regular boundaries considered. Independent exact sample Gram determinants verified ([2] regular +2; [1,1] regular -1; [2,3] singular +6; [1,2,1] regular +6). The published exact exceptional-curve configuration is a needed nontrivial input; its statement was compared with primary arxiv:2610.07164.
